title: Failing blower starves the treatment unit of oxygen; the drainfield ponding is a symptom, not the disease
teaches: Cross-component root-cause correlation. The model treats components in isolation and will report 'low DO', 'cloudy effluent', 'field ponding' and 'heavy filter soiling' as four separate problems -- and will blame the ponding on field age. The deterministic layer connects them: the blower is failing, and everything downstream is a consequence.
_comment_pii: Local-only identity fields, stripped before the model sees anything. All invented.
